Token decimals, set to 8 in the constructor.

safeAdd(uint a, uint b) returns a + b after requiring no overflow.
safeSub(uint a, uint b) returns a - b after requiring b <= a.
safeMul(uint a, uint b) returns a * b after requiring no overflow.
safeDiv(uint a, uint b) returns a / b after requiring b > 0.
Constructor of Owned that assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stores _newOwner into newOwner.
Transfers ownership to newOwner when msg.sender == newOwner and clears newOwner.
Constructor of Navicoin that initialises metadata, total supply and pre-mints the whole supply.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with an unchecked subtraction.
Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub and safeAdd.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without any allowance race protection.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and decreases allowed[from][msg.sender].
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Approves spender and then executes an arbitrary external call to receiveApproval on the spender contract.
Payable fallback function that immediately reverts, rejecting Ether.
onlyOwner function performing an arbitrary external ERC20 transfer call to tokenAddress.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances and allowance keying throughout the contract.
Raw addition c = a + b evaluated before the overflow require in safeAdd.
Raw subtraction c = a - b evaluated before the underflow require in safeSub.
Raw multiplication c = a * b in safeMul.
Raw division c = a / b in safeDiv.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] inside totalSupply without SafeMath.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after approval, enabling reentrancy.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary attacker-controlled contract.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged role from untrusted input.
transferOwnership writes the nominated address into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after promotion.
Constructor writes the token symbol state variable.
Constructor writes the token name state variable.
Constructor writes the decimals state variable.
Constructor writes the fixed _totalSupply value.
Constructor pre-mints the whole supply into balances[0xB20105DC8A3a764e4Ba144D59da562a09f632203].
totalSupply feeds _totalSupply and balances[address(0)] into an unchecked subtraction.
approveAndCall pushes spender, tokens and data into the external receiveApproval call.
transferAnyERC20Token passes tokenAddress and tokens to the external ERC20 transfer call.
msg.sender becomes the owner in the Owned constructor.
msg.sender is compared with owner by the onlyOwner modifier of transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transfer debits and credits balances keyed by msg.sender.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], keyed by the caller.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender], keyed by the caller.
approveAndCall approves and forwards msg.sender to the external callback.
onlyOwner modifier reads the owner state variable to authorise transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership reads and updates the owner state variable and emits OwnershipTransferred.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to validate the accepting caller.
totalSupply returns the stored _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the supply without SafeMath.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer reads and writes balances for sender and recipient via safeSub/safeAdd.
transferFrom reads and writes balances[from] and balances[to] via safeSub/safeAdd.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping of the caller.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
safeAdd performs the raw addition a + b before validating it.
safeSub performs the raw subtraction a - b before validating it.
safeMul performs the raw multiplication a * b.
safeDiv performs the raw division a / b.
transfer calls safeSub on the caller balance.
transfer calls safeAdd on the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub on balances[from] and on the allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd on balances[to].
The external receiveApproval call can re-enter approveAndCall and related state before the approval is finalised.
Parameter a is an operand of the raw addition in safeAdd.
Parameter b is an operand of the raw addition in safeAdd.
Local return variable c receives the unchecked addition result.
Parameter a is the minuend of the raw subtraction in safeSub.
Parameter b is the subtrahend of the raw subtraction in safeSub.
Local return variable c receives the unchecked subtraction result.
Parameter a is an operand of the raw multiplication in safeMul.
Parameter b is an operand of the raw multiplication in safeMul.
Local return variable c receives the unchecked product.
Parameter a is the dividend of the raw division in safeDiv.
Parameter b is the divisor of the raw division in safeDiv.
Local return variable c receives the quotient.
_newOwner parameter is consumed by transferOwnership.
_newOwner becomes the pending newOwner, controlling who can seize ownership.
tokenOwner parameter indexes balances in balanceOf.
to parameter is the credit target of transfer.
tokens parameter is subtracted from and added to balances via SafeMath.
spender parameter keys the allowance written by approve.
tokens parameter is stored as the allowance amount.
from parameter is the debit account of transferFrom.
to parameter is the credit account of transferFrom.
tokens parameter is subtracted and added through SafeMath in transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter keys the allowance lookup.
spender parameter keys the allowance lookup.
spender parameter receives allowance and is called back.
tokens parameter sets the allowance before the callback.
data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval callback.
tokenAddress parameter selects the arbitrary external contract invoked by the owner.
tokens parameter is the amount forwarded to the external token transfer.
transferAnyERC20Token sends the recovered tokens to the owner address and is gated by onlyOwner.
